outcome: Inaccuracies in Certificates of Live Birth
Incompleteness in Certificates of Live Birth
cohort: 3,537 mothers living in Itapema, Santa Catarina, Brazil, whose Certificates of Live Birth were issued from 2011 to 2015.
finding: Data completeness in Certificates of Live Birth was considered excellent for most variables, and the classification of inaccuracies was excellent for all variables.
